purpose: Read-only feasibility research, not production validation or a full vocabulary audit
method: Downloaded the public archive once with curl; decompressed and parsed data.* in memory with Node. Resolved lexical pointers using source and target word indices, not synset membership. No archive extraction or installation on disk.
limitations: Finding ten source entries is not an audit of all 13860 frozen input entries or all English forms.
No outgoing + or backslash pointer was observed for undermine in this probe; absence of a pointer does not prove absence of valid English derivatives.
WordNet morphological normalization can accept malformed words; it is not sufficient on its own as a spelling validator.
A lexical derivation edge does not establish that a generated passage uses the correct sense or has a correct contextual meaning.
No standalone LICENSE entry was observed in the dictionary archive listing; implementation must retain the embedded index/data copyright and license notices and package attribution.
The official download landing pages returned tool errors; the official archive endpoint and reference manual were accessible.
